text:
alex: Pacific change window in 25m. Quick checklist: pin decisions, smoke, rollback ownership, and freeze exceptions.

maya: Recommend canary pin only. Keep stable on v4.1.0. No infra changes during window.

pm: Add note to release log: "v4.1.1: minor embeddings cache fix; no schema change." I'll lock the doc.

maya: Smoke steps: run fast smoke script, 10 embedding samples, run end-to-end gen on main flow. Should take <10m.

ops-bot: @maya acknowledged. Running pin: `/deploy pin --env=canary --version=v4.1.1`

ops-bot: Pin complete. Audit id: audit-3111112240.

maya: I'll run smoke now and post results.

maya: Smoke: 10/10 success, median latency 150ms, p95 260ms. No regressions.

alex: Assign rollback owners: maya -> FF toggle owner, alex -> full rollback owner. SRE -> traffic ops.

sre-oncall: Monitoring thresholds set: p99 > 700ms or error delta > 0.5%. I'll post baselines at +5m.

alex: Rollback commands for quick reference: FF toggle `ffctl set embeddings_cache off --env=canary` and full rollback `/deploy rollback --to-version=v4.1.0`.

maya: FF toggle ready but won't run unless we see signals. I'll be watching logs and similarity drift.

ops-bot: Canary traffic holdpoint created at 3111112280. Use `/deploy shift --to=canary --pct=10` to start.

alex: 10% shift now. Keep updates short: [INFO], [ALERT], [ROLLBACK]. Locking channel for updates only once window starts.

sre-oncall: +5m baseline: error delta +0.01%, p99 690ms. Proceeding to 30% in 10m if stable.

maya: Standing by for FF toggle or rollback instruction.

pm: Customer-facing note queued if we need to communicate.

alex: Thanks all. Rapid updates only during window.
